customer_segment: Brazilian individuals and small businesses selling used goods locally (C2C/B2C sellers using OLX to find a buyer and complete a sale)
end_activity: Complete the exchange (receive payment and hand over the item) with minimal risk and hassle

activities.activity: Decide to sell an item and set basic expectations (target price, acceptable condition, preferred local meet-up vs. delivery)
activities.customer_goal: Convert an unused item into cash with acceptable effort and safety

activities.activity: Create and publish a listing (photos, description, price) to reach potential buyers
activities.current_provider: OLX Brazil classifieds listing flow; seller provides content
activities.customer_goal: Get the item visible quickly to a large audience and attract inquiries

activities.activity: Get discovered by relevant buyers through search, browsing, and filtering
activities.current_provider: OLX Brazil search & discovery features (digital classifieds)
activities.customer_goal: Generate buyer attention efficiently (views/leads) without needing an intermediary

activities.activity: Communicate with interested buyers, answer questions, and negotiate terms
activities.current_provider: OLX Brazil direct messaging / in-app chat; seller and buyer coordinate details
activities.customer_goal: Convert interest into a firm agreement on price, timing, and conditions

activities.activity: Arrange payment method and manage trust/safety risk (fraud concerns, identity confidence, payment security)
activities.current_provider: mostly self/off-platform arrangements; limited platform support implied; external payment methods if used
activities.customer_goal: Get paid securely and avoid scams or disputes

activities.activity: Coordinate delivery or local pickup/meet-up and finalize handoff
activities.customer_goal: Complete the exchange conveniently and safely with minimal time/effort

profile_vs_cvc_conflicts: Company profile emphasizes OLX’s value in search/discovery and matching/negotiation, but the CVC shows major value-eroding steps remain in payment security/trust and logistics/hand-off, which are largely user-coordinated today (E7, E9).

Company profile frames the ‘stated buyer’ primarily as sellers who post listings and buy premium placement, but the customer workflow depends critically on buyer-side discovery and engagement to complete the seller’s job-to-be-done (E7, E8, E11).
